rules: All seven fields are mandatory before each phase.
Authorized paths are a strict allowlist.
The self-test must not hard-code a terminal/latest Human Decision ID set.

Repository discovery may accept valid append-only growth but must still fail on duplicate IDs, malformed IDs, orphan chains, inconsistent prompt/result/review/decision links and invalid queue transitions.
Historical coordination JSON records are immutable and must not be edited.
agent_handoff_protocol.py and all acquisition runtime are read-only invariants.
The exact tested self-test blob merged to integration must be copied to the authoritative coordination branch after merge; no other implementation file may be synced.
Any scope widening stops for new Human authority.

defect_acceptance.current_failure: Authoritative static test enumerates Human Decisions only through H22 and rejects valid H23-H25 append-only growth.
required_fix: Derive the current decision set from discovered valid records or assert stable historical anchors plus monotonic append-only properties.
Add a deterministic future-decision case that passes only with a complete valid chain.
Add negative cases for orphan, duplicate, malformed and unrelated Human Decisions.
Prove the current authoritative bundle passes without updating an expected terminal ID list.

level_3: full deterministic corpus on exact PR head

instructions: Validate KU2D-SCOPE-000003 and each phase declaration before editing.
Inspect AH18 and the authoritative H23-H25 history.
Make the fixture append-only-aware without changing agent_handoff_protocol.py.
Retain and extend negative tests; do not replace exact validation with a count-only assertion.
Run targeted tests, authoritative bundle validation and one exact-head full corpus.
Open one PR, require Data Acquisition CI, squash-merge to integration, then sync only the exact tested self-test blob to the authoritative coordination branch.
Rerun the authoritative static self-test and complete bundle after sync.
Close KU2D-CJ-000006 and submit KU2D-R-000057 with exact head/tree, PR/CI/merge, blob equality, invariants and zero-provider evidence.
